headline: March inflation steady at 3.1%, rent growth slowest in 16 years
caption: Good news for renters and property investors! Rent growth has hit its lowest rate in 16 years, while overall inflation remains steady. This could signal shifting dynamics in the property market — worth keeping an eye on whether it affects investment returns and tenant demand here in East Auckland.
original_title: March quarter inflation steady at 3.1%, continues to breach RBNZ target range
